check: scan for silently-skipped or vacuous tests
why: A test that cannot fail is worse than no test, because it reports coverage that does not exist. The suite is used as acceptance evidence, so the shapes that produce that were searched for directly.
disabledTestsNote: No @Disabled, @Ignore, assumeTrue or Assumptions anywhere in src/test or src/gametest, so nothing is skipped at runtime.

broadCatchReview.why: closes the reservation then rethrows, so the failure still surfaces
returns the error into the future, and assertInstanceOf asserts on it, so it is checked rather than swallowed

falsePositive: A first pass flagged PaletteResolverTest.malformedExistingResourcesNeverFallBackToDefaults as having no assertion. It calls a private invalid(...) helper that runs assertThrows plus assertEquals; my pattern only recognised literal assert/fail calls. Recorded so the same false alarm is not raised again.
